scope: Bounded isolated 100k IOC acceptance plus matched-budget unchanged M0 InfoBAX/Random comparison using accepted B7 per-frame noise and frozen references; no real-machine or GUI changes
forecast_noise_interpretation: Existing fixed future-query noise assumption retained; only revealed observations receive per-frame noise estimates. No hidden reference or future frame enters pool noise.
pairing: Both policies use the same initial design and the same cached actual frame for each (case, policy seed, query index); a query-indexed independent elegant seed is shared if both policies select that query
observations: Actual positive corrected count-image variances with per-frame uncertainty; no synthetic additive Gaussian noise
reference: B7 primary full-scan weighted emittance reference audited against entrance particles and B5 independent seeds; evaluator-only finite-precision target
numerical_policy: InfoBAXConfig defaults retained; only seed varies. Existing GP, acquisition, physicality functional and future-query fixed forecast remain unchanged
failure_policy: Retain quality failures, unavailable recommendations, degraded EIG, and incomplete budgets; no retries, clipping, seed changes or conditional-only success claims
continuation: Run all 16 prespecified paired seeds on both cases after B7 and actual IOC gates pass; preserve all prior evidence and stop without tuning if any frozen benchmark gate fails.
